description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (34.639) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (35.166) less the matching prior-year period (24.369).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 34.639，加本财年累计 35.166，减去上年同期累计 24.369。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Accelerator ramps slip and PC or embedded sales provide limited offset.
rationale.zh: 加速器放量延后，PC 与嵌入式业务抵消有限。

rationale.en: Accelerators and server CPUs scale with better blended profitability.
rationale.zh: 加速器与服务器 CPU 增长，综合盈利改善。

rationale.en: A broader AI customer base and product mix sustain faster growth.
rationale.zh: AI 客户群扩大，产品组合支撑更快增长。
